findings.title: Experiment child inherits persistent control and recovery read descriptors
findings.evidence: src/workbench/terminal/shell_g2/lifecycle.py child fork branch closes only local pipe ends before os.execvpe; inheritable shell FDs 8 and 7 remain open, so a payload can consume later TAKEOVER/RUN or recovery frames.
findings.required_correction: Close every persistent control/recovery/request descriptor not explicitly required by the payload before exec, and add an independent runtime FD-inventory/control-frame non-inheritance test.

exec_ack_disposition: PTRACE exec-event acknowledgement and fail-closed denial/pre-exec behavior had no additional P0-P2 finding.
scope_limit: Review covers the common RUN seam only; input/jobs, manual hook, takeover migration and six-item matrix integration remain incomplete.
